scope: Initial serial storage-buffered deployment; static art and typed proposal only. This additive stage record preserves the reviewed D02/D07 direct-feed, surplus and gated-merge upgrade unchanged.
phase_sequence: D06: initial serial intake/cooker/storage/requested counter supply
D02/D07 upgrade: direct fresh counter supply, controlled surplus, exclusive fresh/stored merge; optional typed assembly
relationship_to_full_upgrade: Initial I03 bypasses the not-yet-installed demand router and sends compatible prepared stock to reserved storage IN. I05/I06 dispatch directly to the only stock source at the counter, so no merge reservation is referenced. The full upgrade adds the direct-feed alternative; storage is not compulsory in that later configuration.

layout.house: Rear food dock faces south/toward camera; original front doors/apron are on the far/north side. Both food sleeves remain on the same rear wall. The original utility/window and fuel sides rotate with the house; fuel remains manual.
layout.production: Intake/cooker to left of house in the northern work band; cooker output enters food IN; separate food OUT runs toward eastern counter. No diverter or merge in this initial installation.
layout.water: A small natural unfrozen water pocket is enclosed within the northwest camp work area. This site choice is a Havenline proposal, not a claim about the original reference. It leaves floor between the water/intake and west/north fence.
layout.service_access: Continuous west outer floor strip connects the left primary gate to the north service aisle behind the rotated house, going around rather than through pond, intake or conveyors. Side service and cooker front face remain accessible.
layout.counter: East boundary opening; staff and keypad west/inside, customers east/outside; register and cash at south end; guarded staff pickup at north stock end.
layout.main_access: Two wide open bidirectional gates in front boundary; clear continuous front walk; stone warmth furnace at camp center with open approaches.
layout.dimensions: Concept allocation only; no exact world dimensions, collision or runtime pathfinding approval.

invariants: All carriers have one transfer owner and retain identity outside their selected processing cycle.
All receiving, holding, inventory and reject capacity is finite; numerical values remain unfrozen.
The cooker reserves output capacity before a cycle; completed output dispatch does not depend on already consumed inputs.
Stored goods remain until explicitly requested; there is no automatic storage OUT-to-IN path.
Initial receiving-full backpressure must not stop a valid requested dispatch that can free inventory capacity.
Food never shares belts with utility materials, fuel, hides or cash.
Raw-food cabinets, fuel, hides/cargo and undefined future recipes stay manual.
This scene does not depict or disable the separate approved full-upgrade design.

evidence.observed_topology: Original A14–16s supports intake/whole-fish/cooker/output; A18–56s and late A/B sequences support staffed stock/service and separate cash.
evidence.new_proposals: Serial warehouse buffering, request/reservation control, new food docks and this enclosed-water-pocket placement are Havenline proposals.
evidence.static_states_elsewhere: D02/D04/D05 show finite receiving/output/stock full states; D03 shows exterior/internal storage interfaces. This overview depicts an ordinary connected state, not a full-house state.
